rationale: Linfeng is a machine learning researcher at Stanford while Fanmin is a senior ML engineer at Apple with deep expertise in production ML infrastructure and systems at scale. They're well-positioned to exchange ideas on bridging research and production—Linfeng's ML research background combined with Fanmin's hands-on experience building scalable ML systems at Amazon and Apple could spark useful conversations about translating research into infrastructure.
intro_message: Linfeng Zhao, meet Fanmin Shi — a Senior ML Engineer at Apple focused on production ML infrastructure who could offer valuable perspective on scaling research into real-world systems.
